answer: Require each agent identity to be anchored to a verifiable hardware-backed vertex: a unique device attestation that cannot be cloned cheaply. New identities enter through a narrow inlet, a rate-limited onboarding queue where each applicant posts a small refundable bond. Honest agents build reputation on a shared terrace of past work, so a fresh Sybil army starts at the bottom with no history and cannot outvote established agents without paying the bond and time cost for every copy.
